search_text: published ZDI-24-900 ZDI-CAN-19105 Parse Server literalizeRegexPart SQL Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2024-07-16 CVE-2024-27298 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-27298 8.6 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:L ['Parse'] ['Server'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Parse Server. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the literalizeRegexPart function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Parse has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Parse Server literalizeRegexPart SQL Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability
